scalars.scalar_value: Experience working with collective bargaining agreements and in union environments preferred

items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or related field and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with collective bargaining agreements and in union environments preferred
MarketPay and PeopleSoft experience highly desired

Join UCLA Health, a leading academic medical center dedicated to improving lives through exceptional patient care, research, and education. As a Compensation Analyst, you’ll play an important role in supporting fair, consistent, and competitive compensation practices in a complex, highly unionized healthcare environment.
Partner with Labor Relations, HR, and organizational leaders to address wage-related disputes, job classifications, and compensation matters.
Support collective bargaining and contract administration through cost analyses, wage calculations, and preparation of documentation for negotiations and grievance proceedings.
Conduct job evaluations, classification reviews, salary analyses, and market benchmarking to support equitable compensation decisions.
Analyze the compensation impact of organizational changes, staffing adjustments, and proposed wage modifications.
Provide guidance on salary offers, pay adjustments, compensation policies, and union wage implementations.
Use data and analytics to identify trends, inform recommendations, and improve compensation practices.
Bring your analytical skills and collaborative approach to a mission-driven organization where supporting our workforce helps advance our commitment to improving patient lives.
Understanding of compensation-related laws and regulations (federal, state, and local), including Fair Labor Standard Act
General knowledge of compensation practices and programs
Advanced Excel skills and advanced skill with MS Office Suite
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills to establish rapport with a wide variety of constituents, including clients, colleagues and all levels of management
Skill in researching information and analyzing data to arrive at valid conclusions, recommendations, and plans of action required
